claims.text: The proposed Wing book (2026-10-26, not booked) collects $477,779 a month gross at the Oct 23 marks, $351,866 net of round-trip execution costs (70% of the $500,000 bogey), with a summed hard worst case of $780,559 inside the $1,000,000 complex cap.
The Wing's prior scoring record was killed on 2026-10-26; the proposed book starts unscored and its record starts at zero when booked.

One position carries a stated defect: N3 (fade the wing) has a 10-day noise band of $27,357 (trailing-60 basis) against $29,760 collected, so its exit rule is thesis-only with no mark-based stop; its size is unchanged. Book marginal VaR95 (episode, 10-day) foots to the $213,182 total: N1 $92,414, N2 $70,236, N3 $66,758, N4 -$6,036, N5 -$6,386, remainder -$3,804.
